# **Principal Engineer**

**Location**: Waterloo, London, England, UK | **Hybrid** (1 day per week in office)

---

## **Who We Are**

At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organisations from early-stage startups to the world's largest companies. We take on hard software challenges and turn them into durable results. We build agentic products, the platforms they run on, and the engineering and design at every layer.

Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.

If this kind of work and our kind of people energises you, you’ve found the right place.

## **Who You Are**

You’ve shown long-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 10+ years. You are a trusted expert and leader, often called upon to guide ambiguous initiatives and architect scalable solutions. You bring a blend of deep consulting acumen, technical expertise, and product thinking that drives measurable and impactful outcomes. In your previous experience, you have:

* Built and shipped production-grade platforms: the reusable foundations, tools, infrastructure, and workflows that help other teams shift faster and more reliably
* Taken AI and agentic systems from prototype to production, with a strong understanding of infrastructure, authentication, and observability
* Delivered on  high-stakes consulting engagements across multiple language paradigms, stacks, ecosystems, and client industries
* Built high-quality, maintainable software collaboratively, incrementally, and through an approach tailored towards the unique needs of the clients you’ve served
* Led the development and delivery of production-grade software using a variety of languages and frameworks, including but not limited to: Java, C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Go, Ruby, Scala, R, and SQL
* Actively experimented with AI development tools and translated that experimentation into faster, higher-quality delivery for your teams
* A track record of understanding, assessing, and embracing new tooling and trends within the software industry
* Built or integrated AI/ML features into products and systems, including recommendation engines, NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics, RAG pipelines, and agents
* Successfully led modernisation and replatforming efforts to align legacy systems with short and long-term business needs
* Led and delivered solutions to architecture-level problems including scalability, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and observability
* Facilitated alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders to move initiatives forward through ambiguity and complexity
* Provided mentorship and team support at scale, while sharing knowledge and improving team practices
* Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs
* Actively sought out and effectively given feedback

## **What You’ll Do At 8th Light**

As a go-to technologist and strategist within 8th Light, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, while continuing to deepen your and our collective domain expertise over the course of your career with us. You’ll be responsible for:

* Rapidly building trust with clients, demonstrating technical expertise and understanding of their domain and objectives
* Driving platform engineering work at the client level, connecting long-term technical vision to what ships
* Leading platform strategy and delivery across diverse platform types, connecting long-term vision to what ships
* Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high-quality work within deadlines
* Advising clients on architecture, scalability and platform evolution, connecting technical decisions to product and business outcomes
* Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring
* Driving innovation by proactively surfacing new technical approaches and product solutions
* Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives
* Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items
* Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values
* Designing and managing high-level technical roadmaps for large engagements
* Building your network and maintaining relationships with clients and other industry leaders within your domain
* Coaching client engineering teams, transferring knowledge and leveling up practices
* Influencing client CTOs and executive decisions. Planning and execute technical work that involves stakeholders outside of project boundaries such as across a client's technical organization
* Partner with account teams on planning, opportunity identification, stakeholder relationships, and pre-sales scope shaping
* Facilitating retrospectives, strategy sessions, and technical deep-dives to improve team and project outcomes
* Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress
* Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes
* Demonstrating leadership in scalable system design, modular architecture, and platform- or product-oriented development
* Bringing depth in testing strategies, observability, fault tolerance, and secure engineering practices
* Applying architectural patterns to evaluate tradeoffs and drive clear, documented design rationale

## **Strongly Preferred Skills**

We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. We would particularly like to encourage applicants with experience in the following areas:

* Platform engineering: building reusable software foundations, internal developer platforms, and infrastructure that other teams build on
* Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics
* Delivering production agentic systems, including RAG pipelines, vector search, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and n8n
* DevSecOps & DevOps
* MLOps
* Infrastructure as Code

Building a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we’re excited to keep learning and growing together. We have a proud tradition of hiring talented colleagues with real-world career experiences.

## **How You’ll be Supported**

At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well-being, and success shape our future.

* Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:
* A robust L&D programme featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.
* Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning & development
* Coworking support for our global team
* 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees

See our full list of Benefits.

## **A Note on Compensation**

At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.

We benchmark our salaries using Geographic Structures to establish competitive pay ranges within the regions where 8th Lights live. Our pay ranges for our Principal Engineer position within London is: £92,818-£116,122 GBP

Reach out to recruiting@8thlight.com for more relevant information pertaining to your local market.

## **8th Light Hubs and Geographies**

8th Light's culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle.

* **London Co-working:** Employees working from our London hub follow a hybrid model, which includes a minimum of one day per week in our Waterloo Office. This co-working day is designed to encourage collaboration and further strengthen our community.In most cases, our consulting engagements do not require travel.

We hope to see you apply!

# Project Manager – Change, Efficiency & Process Improvement

**Salary:** £45,000 per year (pro rata)

**Hours:** 25 hours a week

**Location:** Hybrid with travel to ABL offices as required

**Closing Date:** 18th October 2026

**Quote reference:** **ABL 928**

**Role Purpose:**

ABL is seeking a highly motivated and self-sufficient Project Manager to lead and deliver a portfolio of business change, operational efficiency, and process improvement initiatives across the organisation. The role will be responsible for managing multiple concurrent projects from inception through to implementation and benefits realisation, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, timescales, budgets and quality standards.

The successful candidate will possess a strong understanding of project management methodologies, particularly PRINCE2, alongside excellent stakeholder engagement, planning and organisational skills. They must be comfortable working independently with minimal supervision whilst operating effectively across multiple workstreams and business functions.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of change, transformation, efficiency and process improvement projects, leading them through the full project lifecycle from business case development and initiation through to implementation and closure. You will develop and maintain project plans, monitor progress, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure projects deliver their agreed objectives and measurable business benefits. Working closely with departments across the organisation, you will identify opportunities to improve efficiency, streamline processes and reduce costs, facilitate process mapping and improvement workshops, and support the implementation of sustainable new ways of working. You will apply PRINCE2 principles to ensure effective project governance, maintain project documentation and RAID logs, and provide clear reporting to senior management and the Change Board. The role will involve building strong stakeholder relationships, facilitating meetings and decision-making forums, and influencing stakeholders to support successful outcomes. You will also define and monitor benefits, ensure improvements are embedded into business operations, and contribute to continuous improvement and lessons learned activities, working alongside the Health Equity Performance Lead where operational or process change is required.

**Key Success Measures**

**The successful candidate will:**

•             Deliver projects on time, within scope and to agreed quality standards.

•             Successfully manage a portfolio of multiple concurrent projects.

•             Achieve measurable operational efficiencies and business improvements.

•             Maintain accurate, timely and effective project governance and reporting.

•             Demonstrate strong stakeholder satisfaction and engagement.

•             Ensure project benefits are realised and sustained following implementation.

This role offers an excellent opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to play a key role in delivering ABL’s strategic change agenda and driving tangible operational improvements across the organisation.

Your unit of ownership: the AI platform layer — agent runtime, context management, tool execution, evaluation harnesses, and prompt engineering for system behaviors. You own sandbox behavior and agent runtime logic; SRE owns sandbox infrastructure and capacity.

We're a growing product team scaling into multiple initiatives, each with a lead, engineers, a design engineer, and an AI-focused engineer.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

These are non-negotiables—the things we'll specifically evaluate you on:

- Experience building production AI systems. Not research — making LLMs reliable at scale. You've dealt with prompt engineering, context management, tool use, or agent orchestration in production.

- Shipping and ownership. You've taken ambiguous AI problems to production with measurable outcomes. You own the full lifecycle — build, evaluate, deploy, monitor, iterate.

- System design for AI. You can design systems that handle the unique challenges of AI: non-deterministic outputs, context window limits, tool execution failures, and cost optimization. You think about reliability, cost, and latency as first-class concerns.

- Evaluation design. You can build evaluation frameworks that catch regressions, measure quality, and give the team confidence to ship AI features. You understand failure taxonomies and know how to create meaningful test sets.

- Debugging and diagnosis. You're hypothesis-driven when things break. You can trace failures across model behavior, data pipelines, and infrastructure to find root causes.

- Judgment as AI evolves. You'll make build-vs-integrate decisions on AI infrastructure with incomplete benchmarks, and course-correct fast as models and providers evolve.

YOU MIGHT ALSO

- Have scalable, distributed-system instincts—you've designed and operated systems that handle high throughput and complex failure modes.

- Have a strong sense for security in AI systems—prompt injection, insecure output handling, supply chain risks.

- Have contributed to open-source AI tooling or infrastructure projects.

THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

- You want an ML research role — we don't train models.

- You primarily want to build user-facing product features and UI.

LOCATION

We're looking for people within two hours of Prague (CET), so the team overlaps for most of the working day.

OUR TECH STACK

- GCP (Cloud Run, GKE, GCS)

- Terraform, Docker

- Datadog

- TypeScript and Python services (you'll read and occasionally modify application code, but deep language expertise isn't required)

- Postgres, Redis

HOW WE WORK

These are real tradeoffs we've made, not aspirations:

- Initiative-driven. We organize around customer problems, not org charts. Problems surface through product feedback, competitive analysis, and direct customer conversations — then we prioritize, build, and ship weekly.

- Customer-obsessed. We solve real problems, not hypothetical ones. Features that don't move customer metrics get cut.

- Iterative by default. We ship small, learn fast, and never get attached to yesterday's code. This means things break sometimes — we fix forward.

- AI-first leverage. We use AI to move faster and focus human time where it matters most. If a tool can do it, a person shouldn't.

- Direct feedback. We give each other actionable feedback immediately. This can feel uncomfortable — we think that's worth it.

- Autonomy with accountability. We trust people to make decisions and hold them to outcomes, not process.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Unlimited AI budget. We don't just allow AI tools — we strongly encourage them. Want to try a new tool? Buy it. Want to automate part of your workflow? Do it.

- Autonomy to do your best work. Want to meet someone to learn from? Set it up. Want a mentor? Go get one. Want to fly out to talk to an important customer? Just ask.

- A real AI product with real customers. You're not building demos or internal tools. Enterprise customers use what you ship, and their feedback drives what you build next.

- A sharp, motivated team that values ownership and candor.

HOW WE HIRE

We respect your time and aim to move fast:

1. Discovery call (online, 30 min). We'll talk about you, how you think and whether there's mutual fit.

2. Technical interview (online, ~1 hour). Meet the team. We'll go deeper on your experience, system design, product thinking, and collaboration. No trick questions — we want to see how you think and build.

3. On-site trial day (1 day). Ship something small to production with us and see how we work together. Compensated.

# Outcome Testing and Controls Assurance Officer

OverviewApplication

**About Allica Bank**

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

**Role Description**

This role is responsible for delivering Outcomes Based Testing (OBT), providing independent, evidence-based assurance that Allica is consistently delivering good customer outcomes in line with the FCA's Consumer Duty. The role also undertakes Secondary Controls Testing in accordance with Allica's Risk Management Framework.

The successful candidate will plan and execute a portfolio of testing activities, communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, and agree, monitor, and support action plans through to resolution. They will work collaboratively with Risk Business Partners and the wider First Line of Defence (1LoD) Controls team.

Beyond completing testing against a defined framework, the role requires a proactive and analytical approach. The role holder will identify root causes, drive meaningful remediation, and provide constructive challenge to stakeholders, helping to improve customer outcomes and strengthen Allica's control environment.

**Principal Accountabilities**

* Conduct outcome-based testing across Allica’s customer facing journeys to assess whether customer outcomes are consistent with Consumer Duty obligations. 
* Review customer cases, communications and operational activity to identify potential customer harm, process weaknesses or customer experience issues, including the treatment of vulnerable customers. 
* Assess both process execution and customer experience, ensuring documentation is complete, communications are clear and customers do not face unnecessary barriers or delays. 
* Communicate Outcomes Based Testing results clearly to relevant stakeholders, ensuring findings are understood and owned. 
* Agree appropriate action plans with stakeholders to remediate instances of poor outcomes and track these through to closure. 
* Deliver Secondary Controls Testing, assessing the design and operating effectiveness to obtain an overall rating for each control, in line with Allica’s Control Testing Standards. 
* Communicate control testing output to stakeholders and agree action plans where control weaknesses or failures are identified. 
* Accurately update RiskSmart with control test results, ratings, findings and associated action plans. 
* Maintain regular engagement with Risk Business Partners across the wider 1LoD Controls team on control testing outputs, sharing themes and supporting a consistent testing approach. 
* Escalate significant issues, risks or thematic concerns in a timely manner. 
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Outcomes Based Testing and controls testing methodology, templates and reporting. 
* Ensure all testing is conducted objectively and independently, in line with Allica's Risk Management Framework and relevant regulatory requirements, including the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules. 
* Support reporting and insight through dashboards and analysis, contributing to root cause identification and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Personal Attributes & Experience**

* Capable of working in a fast-paced environment, managing complex, competing and alternating priorities across control testing and outcomes based testing with a constant focus on delivery. 
* Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify root causes behind poor customer outcomes or control failures, not just symptoms. 
* A confident, clear communicator, able to present findings and constructively challenge stakeholders at varying levels of seniority. 
* Show curiosity and sound judgement when assessing customer journeys and identifying potential customer harm or process weaknesses. 
* Demonstrate a proactive and solution-focused mindset, with a desire to improve processes and customer experience. 
* Be able to work independently with minimal supervision, while remaining a collaborative and engaged member of the wider team. 
* Have experience of controls testing, quality assurance, outcomes-based testing, or 1st/2nd line risk and assurance work, ideally within Financial Services. 
* Have a working knowledge of the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules, and how these apply in practice to Allica’s products and supporting customer journeys. 
* Be explicit in demonstrating where they've gone the extra mile, embraced new challenges, or stood out from their peers in a previous testing, assurance or risk role.

**Working at Allica Bank**

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

* Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

* Regular social activities
* Pension contributions
* Discretionary bonus scheme
* Private health cover
* Life assurance
* Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

**Don’t tick every box?**

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

**Flexible working**

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

# Director of Engineering

UK-wide leadership role

Here at AMP, we are committed to supporting the energy transition by funding, developing, and delivering flexible energy solutions and helping businesses decarbonise. Our mission is to create a smarter energy future. We are relentless in our focus on tackling the central challenge of our age - the energy transition.

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineering leader to join AMP as our **Director of Engineering**, reporting directly to our Chief Executive Officer and joining our Executive Team.

As our portfolio and pipeline continue to grow, the Director of Engineering will establish and lead a dedicated engineering function, bringing together the strong engineering capability that already exists across the business and introducing a consistent approach to engineering standards, governance and technical decision-making.

With more than 280 operational assets totalling 312MW, our portfolio spans industrial and commercial heat, flexible generation and electricity storage, using technologies including biomass boilers, electric boilers, gas peakers, CHP and batteries.

The successful individual will have the opportunity to shape how engineering works across AMP. From the technical decisions made at the earliest stages of a project, through design, construction and commissioning, to the performance and reliability of our operational assets, this role will provide engineering leadership across the full asset lifecycle. The Director of Engineering will hold ultimate technical authority across the business, establishing AMP's engineering standards and delegated authority framework, providing technical assurance on investment decisions and ensuring that our projects are designed, delivered and handed over to Operations to the standards we expect

If you're looking for a role where you can make a genuine impact within a growing business at the forefront of the energy transition, we'd love to hear from you.

## The role will involve

Working across AMP and alongside colleagues in Development, Delivery, Operations, Asset Management, HSEQ and our wider Executive Team, you will:

* Establish and lead AMP's engineering function, creating clear engineering standards, governance and technical decision-making across the business.
* Develop and own our technical governance framework, including delegated technical authority, management of change and engineering approval gates.
* Lead the technical pre-construction phase of our projects, including technical specifications, technology and vendor selection and employer's requirements.
* Own the technical content of EPC and construction contracts, ensuring appropriate performance standards, guarantees, commissioning requirements and test regimes are in place.
* Provide independent technical assurance throughout project development and delivery, with final technical authority for significant design, technology and engineering decisions.
* Establish and oversee a robust technical handover process from Delivery into Operations.
* Provide senior engineering support across our operational portfolio, including the investigation of significant asset failures and ensuring lessons learned are incorporated into future standards and designs.
* Lead technical due diligence for acquisitions, new technologies and new areas of business.
* Ensure engineering quality, technical documentation and statutory requirements are maintained to a high standard.
* Build, lead and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team, creating clear competence standards and supporting the professional development of our engineers.
* Ensure the technical solutions we develop are not only fit for purpose, but commercially viable and deliver value for money.
* The role carries genuine technical authority, including the ability to stop work on technical or safety grounds where required.

## What we are looking for

We are looking for an accomplished engineering leader with the technical credibility, commercial understanding and leadership capability to establish and develop an engineering function within a growing energy business.

You will be a Chartered Engineer, within electrical, mechanical, power systems or a related discipline, with significant post-qualification experience in power generation, energy storage, distributed energy or comparable asset-intensive infrastructure.

Importantly, you will have demonstrable experience of building or substantially developing an engineering function, including the standards, governance and technical authority that sit behind it, alongside:

* Proven experience leading and developing multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Strong experience across the project lifecycle, particularly technical pre-construction, design assurance, commissioning and handover.
* Experience developing employer's requirements, technical specifications, performance standards and test regimes.
* The technical judgement and confidence to make significant engineering decisions and take accountability for them.
* Strong commercial awareness, with experience of contracts, budgets, vendor negotiations and investment decisions.
* Experience operating effectively at senior leadership level and communicating complex technical matters clearly to commercial and non-technical stakeholders.
* A practical approach to problem solving, with the ability to balance engineering excellence, operational requirements and commercial considerations.

Experience of battery energy storage, HV connections and DNO/NESO interfaces would be advantageous, as would experience within heat networks, biomass or industrial energy centres, CDM Principal Designer responsibilities and HV authorised person regimes.

job_description:
**Principal Product Management – Software and Digital Platforms**

The Principal/Sr. Principal Product Manager for Software and Digital Platforms (SDP) is a senior individual contributor responsible for defining products, translating market and business needs into executable requirements, and driving alignment across business units, engineering, and program teams. This role serves as a technical and commercial bridge between vertical end-market teams and the SW, Digital, and AI development teams.

**Key Product Management Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business unit marketing, engineering teams, and customers to translate business needs for SW, Digital, and AI either into stakeholder product requirements, focusing on the “what” needs to be built and the “why”.
* Define product scope, use cases, feature priorities, and requirements for software and digital platform offerings, ensuring requirements are technically sound, validated with engineering, traceable and verifiable through delivery.
* Work closely with software, embedded, systems, and hardware engineering teams to refine requirements, resolve tradeoffs, and ensure products are architected for usability, scalability, and reuse across multiple markets.
* Contribute to roadmap planning and prioritization for software-enabled products and platform capabilities, balancing customer demand, strategic value, technical feasibility, and resource constraints.
* Develop business cases and support project scoping, including assessment of development effort, cost considerations, lifecycle implications, and long-term platform reuse opportunities.
* Clarify the product lifecycle from concept through launch, support, and end of life, ensuring clear plans for release readiness, sustaining needs, and customer adoption.
* Engage directly with customers and internal stakeholders to gather insights, evaluate product fit, and shape product direction based on application needs, feedback, and competitive dynamics.
* Partner with program management and development teams during quarterly planning and execution cycles to provide clear priorities, decision support, and visibility to roadmap changes, risks, and dependencies.
* Influence platform strategy by identifying opportunities to standardize software components, improve developer experience, and expand reusability of embedded software and digital assets across product lines.
* Collaborate with vertical business unit applications, marketing, and enablement teams to ensure product requirements, positioning, documentation, and customer-facing collateral accurately reflect the intended value proposition and technical capabilities.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* Partner with vertical BU applications and engineering teams to ensure early customer experience, evaluation flows, and product readiness considerations are incorporated into product plans.
* Work with embedded software and systems teams to understand architecture decisions, development tradeoffs, and validation needs in order to make informed product decisions.
* Support go-to-market readiness by aligning product documentation, evaluation platforms, and customer-facing collateral with roadmap commitments and launch objectives.
* Help drive issue resolution and prioritization across development, applications, and support teams throughout the product lifecycle.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related technical field; advanced degree or MBA is a plus.
* 10+ years of experience in product management, systems engineering, applications engineering, or a related role supporting embedded products.
* Demonstrated experience managing or defining products that include embedded software, firmware, or software-enabled hardware platforms.
* Hands-on understanding of embedded software development practices, software lifecycle considerations, and the interaction between firmware, drivers, middleware, hardware, and end applications.
* Experience translating customer and market needs into detailed product requirements and driving cross-functional alignment through execution.
* Strong technical and business judgment, including the ability to assess product tradeoffs, prioritize features, and contribute to business case development.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence engineering, business, and customer teams without direct authority.
* Understanding of competitive dynamics, customer workflows, and software platform trends in embedded and digital product environments.

As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. #### **Customer problems**

You’ll become one of the team who understands our product most deeply because you’ll see it through the eyes of the people actually using it.

* Investigate problems across our hardware, embedded software, connectivity, cloud platform and web application.
* Reproduce failures rather than simply recording symptoms.
* Collect and analyse logs, telemetry and other diagnostic information.
* Communicate clearly with customers while issues are being investigated.
* Distinguish isolated incidents from systemic product problems.
* Identify recurring issues and make sure they feed back into engineering and product decisions.
* Follow problems through to resolution rather than treating escalation as the end of your involvement.

#### **Product quality**

You'll also be responsible for actively trying to break what we're building before customers do.

You will:

* Test new features and releases end-to-end across devices, connectivity, cloud services and the user interface.
* Design and maintain regression coverage for important customer workflows.
* Simulate real-world operating conditions including poor connectivity, power loss, interrupted uploads, long-running usage and unusual state transitions.
* Explore edge cases that aren't covered by happy-path test plans.
* Reproduce bugs and give engineers precise, useful information about how they occur.
* Verify fixes and turn customer-reported failures into regression tests.
* Help us understand the real quality and reliability of each release.
* Work with engineers early in development to make features easier to test, diagnose and support.

Quality is not something you own instead of engineering - engineers remain responsible for the quality of what they build. Your job is to provide an independent, end-to-end view of whether the product actually works in the real world.

### **Continual improvement**

**You should constantly be looking for ways to make yourself, the team and the product more effective.**

That might mean:

* Building scripts to gather diagnostics automatically.
* Creating tools that reproduce difficult device states.
* Improving dashboards and observability.
* Building internal support tools.
* Using AI agents to investigate logs, correlate telemetry or triage support cases.
* Generating targeted test cases from code changes or bug reports.

**Some of these solutions might be a Python script written in twenty minutes, some might be an AI agent, and some might require working with product and engineering for a more fundamental process change.**

### **What the first 90 days look like**

#### **Days 1–30 — Learn it and break it**

Use the product constantly, set up our devices, wear them. Disconnect them from networks, run batteries flat, interrupt uploads. Generate events, explore the Console, look through logs, work through previous bugs and customer issues.

By the end of the first month, you should understand the system well enough to independently investigate most customer problems and have strong opinions about where our biggest quality and diagnostic gaps are.

#### **Days 30–60 — Own the loop**

Be integrated as a primary member of our technical support process and end-to-end product testing.

Improve our processes for reproducing, triaging and following issues through to resolution. Help identify repetitive work and eliminating it using automation and AI.

#### **Days 60–90 — Make it scale**

Expand our systems and processes to ensure that support and QA don’t become increasingly manual as we grow.

Establish useful regression coverage, support tooling, diagnostic workflows and automation.

And when something new breaks, we should learn from it once.

### **How we work**

#### **AI-first, not AI-curious**

AI is part of how Antare operates.

We use tools such as Claude, Cursor and agentic development environments every day to write software, investigate problems, analyse data and move faster.

You definitely don't need to be a Machine Learning expert, but you should be constantly asking how modern tools can make you more effective.

If an AI agent can analyse 20,000 log lines faster than you can, use it.

If you can prototype a diagnostic tool yourself with AI-assisted coding rather than waiting two weeks for engineering capacity, build it.

If an agent can turn a bug report and recent code changes into a targeted test plan, try it.

The expectation isn't that every AI experiment works. The expectation is that you're willing to explore the frontier rather than falling back automatically to manual processes.

#### **Be an owner**

If a customer has a problem, your responsibility doesn't end when you've created a ticket.

If diagnostics are bad, help improve them. If the same issue keeps appearing, find out why. If a tool would make the job easier, build it.

#### **Get to the root cause**

“Rebooting fixed it” is useful information, but it isn't an explanation.

We care about understanding why systems behave the way they do.

#### **Customer first, always**

Start with the reality of the people using our products.

Understand their environment, the pressures they're under and what actually happened.

Being customer-first doesn't mean saying yes to every request. It means understanding the problem deeply enough to solve the right one.

## **What we're looking for**

We're more interested in how you think and operate than whether you've previously had exactly this job title.

You might come from QA, technical support, systems engineering, solutions engineering, software engineering or something else entirely.

We think you'll probably have:

* Strong technical troubleshooting instincts.
* A structured and methodical approach to investigating problems.
* A tendency to ask “why?” until you actually understand the failure.
* Confidence working directly with customers.
* Excellent written communication.
* Comfort working with logs, APIs and browser development tools.
* Some familiarity with networking and connected devices.
* The ability to write lightweight scripts or small tools — Python, Bash, Go or similar.
* An interest in using AI and automation to solve problems rather than simply completing tasks manually.
* Good judgement about when to investigate independently and when to pull in another engineer.
* Attention to detail without losing sight of the wider system.
* The ability to move between a customer conversation and a deep technical investigation without finding either unusual.

You don't need to arrive knowing our entire technology stack. We care much more about curiosity, resourcefulness and your ability to learn quickly.

### **Nice to haves**

#### **Any of these would be useful, but none are requirements:**

* Experience testing hardware, IoT or embedded products.
* Experience supporting technical B2B products.
* Cellular, Wi-Fi or general networking knowledge.
* Linux experience.
* Video or audio systems.
* Automated testing.
* Hardware debugging.
* APIs and cloud infrastructure.
* Building internal tools.
* AI-assisted software development or agentic workflows.
* Experience in an early-stage startup.

### **What we're not looking for**

**This probably isn't the role for you if:**

* You're looking for a traditional customer-service or call-centre support role.
* You think support means forwarding technical problems to engineering.
* Your preferred approach to QA is simply following predefined scripts.
* You're uncomfortable investigating logs, devices, APIs or technical systems.
* You need someone else to build every tool or automation you identify.
* You instinctively treat coding, tooling or process improvement as another team's responsibility.
* You want a narrow, predictable remit where problems always fall neatly inside your job description.

There will be days when you're reproducing a subtle device failure, talking to a customer, reviewing a release candidate and building a small internal tool within the space of a few hours.

**We believe diverse perspectives make better products, and we strongly encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech to apply. If you're unsure whether you meet every requirement, please still reach out — we'd love to hear from you.**

### **Why Antare**

Join Antare in London and contribute to a team that's creating the next generation of innovative physical security products.

We offer a competitive salary, equity options and healthcare, along with the opportunity to build a product that makes a real impact.

We're primarily an in-person team, typically 4–5 days per week. At this stage of the company, we've found that collaboration, problem solving and ideation happen faster and more naturally when we're in the same room.

You'll also spend time close to customers and the environments in which our products are actually used.

### **Our values**

#### **Be an owner**

Owners take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

Sweat the details. Fix problems when you see them.

If something needs doing, do it.

#### **Say it straight**

Be honest. Be direct. Be transparent.

Surface problems early. Say what's real, even when it's uncomfortable.

Trust is built through straight talking.

#### **Customer first, always**

Start with the reality of the people using our products.

Understand their environments, the pressures they face and the moments that matter.

Build for the real world.

#### **Decide and adapt**

Focus wins. Form a clear view and move.

Decide with the information you have. When new evidence appears, update your view and keep moving.

Don't be afraid to change your mind. Disagree openly, then commit.

#### **Be bold**

Stay curious. Look ahead.

Try new tools, technologies and ideas — especially the ones that challenge how things have always been done.

Aim higher than feels comfortable. Small ambitions produce small outcomes.

**Generic Responsibilities**

* **Backlog & Roadmap Ownership:** Translate high-level strategic visions (from the Head of Experience) into a prioritized, actionable product backlog. Ensure the backlog is always "Ready" for developers.
* **The "Standardization" Guardian:** Strictly enforce the 70% Standard / 30% Specific ratio. Resist custom developments that create technical debt and champion reusable, scalable features to stop the "redo" cycle.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Act as the decisive pivot between Engineering, Quality Assurance, UX/UI, and Business Analysts. Resolve conflicts and ensure the Squad reaches its Sprint goals.
* **Gap Analysis Validation:** Work closely with Business Analysts and Market PMs to review client tenders. Define how to configure existing standard tools to meet client needs without rewriting core code.
* **Quality & Acceptance:** Define clear "Definition of Done" criteria. Validate that the delivered software meets the functional goal before handing it over to the Delivery Managers for rollout.

**Domain-Specific Responsibilities (Data Expertise)**

* **Dashboard Building & Visualization:** Define, design, and actively build intuitive data dashboards (using tools like PowerBI, Tableau, or embedded BI solutions). You will create operational dashboards for internal monitoring and client-facing dashboards that translate complex transit data into actionable insights.
* **Data Lake Integration:** Lead the integration of the BU Transport's data streams into the global Arrive Group Data Lake, ensuring data quality, consistency, and compliance (GDPR).

1. **With the product team:** You align your Data roadmap with the broader business model.
2. **With Technology:** You define the *Functional Data Need* (the "What" and "Why"), while relying on the Technology team to provide the underlying infrastructure and architecture (the "How").

# Staff Software Engineer

Anywhere

**Job Description:**

B12's engineering team views software as a craft, but improving the world as the reason to practice it. Our engineers are responsible for prioritizing, conceptualizing, co-designing, building, testing, and engaging users for any concept we are building out. We’re generalists in encouraging each other to experience the full stack, but we’re also aware of each other’s preferences in the stack. For this role in particular, we’re searching for a tenured full-stack engineer who brings strong backend/infrastructure skills (and an interest in using them) to the product. We mentor and teach where we can, both inside and outside of the company, and as a Staff Software Engineer, you will be responsible not only for your ownership of major projects, but also mentorship of the team members with whom you ship those projects.

We value sharing our work with the outside world. Our team has published papers on forming expert flash teams and machine-mediated worker hierarchies. We’ve baked our research into various open source tools in the space of creativity, expertise, and knowledge work.

We hope our engineers have more longevity than any one tool we use, but here is a sampling of our current thoughts about technology:

* We live on Python/Django and TypeScript/React.
* We store blobs in Amazon’s S3, munch on them in Amazon’s EC2, develop in Docker, and deploy containers to Amazon’s Elastic Beanstalk.
* We believe PostgreSQL should be the first system you consider when thinking about persisting structured data.
* We clean and centralize data in Amazon’s Redshift, and are able to answer almost any question in SQL.
* We leverage AI in our product and our internal tooling, and faced with a landscape in constant flux, try to pick the right model or agent on a task-by-task basis.
* Our new code is almost 100% LLM-generated, and we’ve thought hard about ensuring quality in the face of ever-increasing review loads, what processes humans are still best at, and how the practice of mentorship must adapt in the face of these new tools.
* We have near-full test coverage on the backend, and are making progress on our frontend and integration tests.
* We set up continuous integration and deployment because, while this model comes with its own pains, we’ve disliked being on fixed release schedules on previous projects.
* We like to move fast and support point-in-time recovery :).

## **You’d be a good fit if**

* You have 10 or more years of experience building products and systems in production.
* You are an amazing communicator.
* You feel comfortable managing your time and deciding among competing priorities.
* You are curious.
* You have a high ownership mentality.
* You enjoy learning and teaching.
* You are comfortable working with backend and frontend technologies, but have a deeper background and interest on the backend/infrastructure side.
* You care about and want to contribute to our mission of helping people do meaningful work.

## **What does a staff engineer do here?**

This is B12’s first Staff Engineer hire on a ~10-person product team that includes a designer, product manager, and CTO. To understand what we’re looking for in someone with this much experience, here are some concrete examples of tasks you’d work on in a month:

* Own the delivery of a project of the magnitude “we ship one or two of these a quarter,” both individually shipping code and rallying and supporting team members in doing so.
* Participate in quarterly planning to identify key projects to work on next quarter.
* Mentor other engineers who are in the planning, prototyping, or implementation phases of a project.
* Respond to an incident, write up a postmortem, and improve tooling and infrastructure to help us prevent or more quickly respond to the issue and others like it in the future.
* Identify and optimize some infrastructure that costs too much, is too slow, or isn’t stable enough.
* Discuss an early design/prototype with a designer or product manager to help shape its direction and explain what will be easy or hard to implement.
* Unblock an operational team member on a data analysis project that answers a hairy question facing our business.
* Run a brainstorm with engineers to identify how we might work more effectively or ship with a higher level of quality.

## **Don’t fear:**

* We highly favor talent and interest.
* Some candidates may see this list and feel discouraged because they don’t match all the items. Please apply anyway: there’s a good chance you’re more wonderful than you think you are.
* B12 is a safe place for human beings. We particularly encourage you to apply if you identify as a woman, are a person of color or other underrepresented minority, or are a member of the LGBTQIA community.

# Key Account Manager - SaaS

Glasgow, Scotland, United Kingdom

Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

**About Berkeley Myles Group:**

Berkeley Myles Group, builds on-premise ERP/MIS software for SME manufacturers — covering MRP, job costing, stock control, works orders and labour tracking, with integrations into Sage, Xero and Pegasus. We work with 700+ customers across motorsport, aerospace, defence and electronics.

Berkeley Myles Group has recently brought Javelin into the business, bringing together two established manufacturing software providers under one roof. We are part of the Banyan Software portfolio and are investing in a cloud relaunch of the platform, landing in Q4 2026 — a genuine growth phase for the business, not a maintenance one.

**The Role:**

This is a new role for Berkeley Myles — created to build a dedicated Account Management function from the ground up. As Key Account Manager, you’ll own and grow our entire existing customer base (700+ SME manufacturers) once integrated, focused on retention, licence expansion and module growth.

You’ll work with production, operations, finance and IT stakeholders inside SME manufacturing businesses — helping them get more value from the system they already run, and identifying where additional modules, users or capability can support their growth.

You report directly to the Commercial Director, and will play a central role in shaping how Berkeley Myles does account management going forward. In our own GTM model, this role owns three stages end to end: Adoption, Expansion, and Advocacy & Referral. Everything before that (Awareness, Nurture, Sales, Close) sits with Marketing and the BDR team — your world starts once a customer is live.

You’ll carry clear commercial targets across retention, renewal and expansion revenue, set by the Commercial Director and reviewed regularly. We’re not looking for someone who manages relationships and waits for renewals to happen; we’re looking for someone who goes after the number. You will:

* Own and grow the full customer base (700+ SME manufacturers) across
* motorsport, aerospace, defence, electronics and beyond
* Build trusted relationships with production, operations, finance and IT stakeholders within existing accounts
* Develop and execute account plans focused on retention, licence expansion and module growth
* Lead commercial conversations on renewals, upsell and expansion — owning the numbers behind them
* Consistently meet or exceed the quarterly and annual retention and expansion revenue targets set for
* the role
* Identify growth opportunities within accounts, working with Support, Implementation and Product to drive adoption and uncover expansion potential
* Spot accounts missing key modules — accounts link, quality, shop floor, debt collection, labour, and time; attendance — and build the case for adding them

### **About the Role**

The Senior FP&A Analyst owns Behavox's core financial model — its architecture, the accounting beneath it, and the forecasts and analysis the company plans and decides by. The role exists to change decisions, not report them: it turns the numbers into the choices leadership actually faces. It reads and integrates budgets into the model, but does not run the budgeting cycle.

The same analyst builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma models behind every acquisition — evaluating targets, running diligence, and folding closed deals into a single consolidated view. This work is periodic and must be carried alone when it arrives; the steady state is the operating model and SaaS forecasting.

This is a high-autonomy role that works without a detailed brief and sets the modeling standard others build on. It is accountable for the accuracy and integrity of the numbers, and for turning them into recommendations sharp enough to act on — the downside case included, not just the point estimate — for senior leadership, the board, and investors. It pressure-tests the assumptions behind every result, works fluently with modern tooling and AI, and compounds that edge by learning relentlessly. Its influence comes from the rigor and reach of the analysis, not from authority: it owns the model and the truth it tells, not the decisions made from it.

### **What You'll Bring**

1. **Financial Model & Accounting Foundations** — Understands the architecture of integrated three-statement and operating models and the accounting that underpins them, including SaaS revenue recognition and cost treatment. Understands how the company's budgets are built and how to integrate them accurately into the core financial model.
2. **Forecasting & SaaS Unit Economics** — Understands bottom-up short-term forecasting, driver-based long-term modeling, and the SaaS metrics that reveal business performance. Connects movements in those metrics to their underlying drivers and the operating levers that can change them.
3. **Mergers, Acquisitions & Integration** — Understands acquisition valuation, purchase accounting, combined-entity projections, and consolidation mechanics sufficiently to evaluate targets and integrate completed acquisitions into the financial model.
4. **Business & Commercial Acumen** — Understands in depth how the business and its functions generate revenue and incur costs, including the underlying revenue drivers, cost structure, and operating levers. Applies this knowledge to identify inconsistencies and challenge financial results and assumptions.
5. **Financial Systems & AI Tooling** — Understands Google Sheets, Excel, AI, and automation capabilities sufficiently to determine how they should be applied to financial modeling and analysis. Distinguishes where automation can improve speed and control from where financial judgment and manual validation must remain.

### **What You'll Do**

2. **Acquisition Modeling & Integration** — Builds valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma combined-entity models by independently evaluating targets, supporting due diligence, and consolidating closed deals to provide a complete financial view of acquisition implications and the combined business.
3. **Business-Review Reporting** — Drives the financial substance of monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews with the broader FP&A team by translating model outputs and performance drivers into a clear narrative that enables senior management, the board, and investors to understand results and their implications.
4. **Metrics Analysis & Business Partnering** — Diagnoses financial and SaaS metric movements by identifying operating drivers, pressure-testing assumptions, and modeling relevant levers and downside cases to give decision-makers evidence-based recommendations they can act on.

As fast as cybercriminals change, we are changing too.

BioCatch is a dynamic startup that takes an innovative approach to combat fraud by unlocking the power of behavior. Leading financial institutions around the globe use BioCatch to more effectively fight fraud, drive digital transformation and accelerate business growth. With employees in 25 countries and over 340 customers on 5 continents, BioCatch’s reach expands around the world.

Come work with intensely curious people who are dedicated to innovation, growth, and protecting customers against cybercrime and fraud!

We are looking for an exceptional customer-facing Threat Analyst to help our prospects and customers optimize their value within BioCatch solutions.

The BioCatch Threat Analyst is a consultancy role that involves a combination of skills. You will be comfortable completing advanced analytics, advising customers on fraud detection/prevention and strategy with your domain knowledge expertise and communicating with customers from C-level to operational fraud investigators. This role is unique in the industry and to be successful, you must be a motivated self-starter who can ramp-up quickly and work autonomously. With a support network of Threat Analysts distributed globally, you will become a key individual in the global fight against digital fraud.

It can be difficult to distill this role down to a regular day-to-day, because every day is different, however some key responsibilities include:

* Maintain strong relationships with fellow fraud fighters within the BioCatch customer base to support and enable them to get maximum value out of the BioCatch solutions.
* Provide subject matter expertise (SME) support to our customers to drive the use of BioCatch in achieving their strategic plans.
* Work with customers and BioCatch Data Science to continually strive for high fraud detection rates, whilst maintaining low levels of friction for genuine customers.
* Use a data-driven approach to prove the value of BioCatch against success criteria for proof of value and pilot projects.
* Educate potential and new customers on BioCatch and Behavioural Biometrics specifically for targeting their key problems and use cases.
* Work tactically with customers to deploy rules for acute fraud attacks.
* Continually focus on leading customers towards best practices.
* Be a voice of the customer to internal BioCatch functions to drive our own product strategy and delivery.
* Support BioCatch Data Science in researching new and emerging threats across our main use cases including Account Takeover, Account Opening, Remote Access Scams, Social Engineering Scams and Mule detection.
* Deliver reporting and insights on fraud detection performance.
* Share interesting stories and learnings from the field with our Sales Enablement function and strive to be a thought leader in the fraud space.Provide SME support to the BioCatch Sales functions to enable them in new customer acquisitions.

* Experience with financial institutions’ fraud departments and/or fraud monitoring tools
* Experience working within cross-functional teams
* Experience with SQL to an intermediate/advanced level
* Experience with Python and/or R (advantage)
* Understanding of statistical modeling techniques

* Full-time role with flexible working hours

job_title: Director, Agentic AI, Data Science Lead, AI Labs
job_description:
**About this role**

**AI Labs Overview**

For more than three decades, BlackRock has combined world-class talent and technology to redefine what's possible in asset management. Today, AI is reshaping every aspect of our industry, from investments and client experiences to operations, risk management, and product innovation. BlackRock AI Labs sits at the center of that transformation.

AI Labs is BlackRock's advanced AI science and engineering organization. We partner with teams across the firm to solve some of the most complex and consequential challenges in financial services, applying generative AI, machine learning, optimization, and statistics to deliver measurable business impact. Our mission is simple but ambitious: combine human and machine intelligence to revolutionize asset management. 

What sets AI Labs apart is our ability to move from idea to impact. We are not a research lab detached from the business, nor are we a traditional software engineering organization. We are a hybrid team of scientists and engineers who build solutions that run at scale in production environments and create capacity for our business partners. From AI-powered investment insights and risk management solutions to next-generation agentic workflows - our work is helping to shape the future of BlackRock.

Our teams work on some of the firm's highest priority strategic initiatives, including large-scale generative AI systems, intelligent agents, predictive analytics, optimization engines, operational risk solutions, and AI platforms that accelerate innovation across BlackRock. We help define best practices, establish technical standards, and enable teams throughout the organization to adopt AI safely, effectively, and at scale.

AI Labs has offices in New York, Edinburgh, Atlanta, San Francisco and Seattle. 

We are looking for candidates with unique backgrounds and diverse skill sets with fresh perspectives to accelerate and amplify our efforts to make an impact at BlackRock.

**Job Description**

As a Data Science Director, you will take end-to-end ownership of flagship AI Labs initiatives - from initial scoping and stakeholder alignment, through research, prototyping, and technical build-out, to testing, iteration, and production deployment. You will partner directly with business and technology stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into well-scoped programs of work, own the solutions architecture, and ensure delivery is reliable and at scale. Alongside this technical and delivery accountability, you will manage and mentor more junior AI scientists, helping to grow their skills, guide their career development, and build a strong bench of talent within AI Labs. This role reports to the Head of Science in AI Labs and manages a team of 3-6 AI scientists.

**Responsibilities**

* Own flagship AI Labs initiatives end-to-end: scoping, stakeholder alignment, research, prototyping, build, and production deployment.
* Partner with senior business and technology stakeholders to turn ambiguous problems into scoped programs with agreed priorities and success criteria.
* Lead the design, build, and evaluation of AI agents and agentic workflows - tool use, memory, multi-step reasoning - on large, complex datasets, iterating as findings emerge.
* Partner with engineering to make solutions production-grade and compliant, with observability, guardrails, and evaluation pipelines in place.
* Manage and mentor AI scientists, guiding technical approach and career growth to build the bench in AI Labs.
* Communicate technical work and outcomes to senior leaders and general audiences, including white papers, publications, and presentations.

**Qualifications**

**Required experience**

* PhD in a quantitative field (machine learning, AI, statistics, computer science, physics, engineering) with 8+ years of professional experience OR
* MS degree in a quantitative field plus 11+ years of professional experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence, or other aspects of the AI / data science and agent development process.
* Track record of leading complex, ambiguous technical initiatives end-to-end, from scoping through production, and delivering measurable business impact.
* Experience managing or mentoring AI scientists or similar technical talent, including supporting their career growth and development.
* Strong familiarity with Python programming, and hands-on experience guiding solutions architecture for production-grade AI/ML systems.
* Strong theoretical background in and practical experience using AI, machine learning, optimization, or statistical techniques.
* Experience assessing performance of machine learning methods and agentic systems: benchmark construction, metric design, and statistically sound measurement of quality, safety, and reliability.

**Additional experience we value:** *you don't need all of these. We're looking for depth in some areas and the range to grow into the rest.*

* Depth in one or more research areas relevant to our work, e.g. LLM reasoning, reinforcement learning, machine learning, statistical modeling, or quantitative optimization.
* Academic publications, preprints, or open-source contributions.
* Experience building and deploying AI agents and agentic workflows using open-source frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents SDK), agent platforms (e.g. Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Agent Framework, Claude Agent SDK), or comparable tools, including standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting agents to tools and data.
* Experience with retrieval systems for agents: retrieval-augmented generation, embedding models, vector databases, and long-term memory.
* Experience with machine learning libraries (e.g. PyTorch, Tensorflow), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and the analysis of financial or economic data.
* Experience helping define technical standards, best practices, or ways of working adopted across multiple teams, and exposure to financial services or another regulated environment.

**Our benefits**

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being.  Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

third-party software applications.

range of internal Pershing technical and non-technical teams, the Client Support

itself and may instead relate to business processes, user activity, or recent
software releases. As such, you will be expected to quickly investigate the
potential source of issues, resolve them where possible, and route them to the
appropriate teams when resolution falls outside the Applications Support Group.

business processes, user activity, or recent software releases, and route
them to the appropriate teams when resolution falls outside the Applications
Support Group.

pressure, and maintain core support coverage across on-site and offshore
support hours.
* Use SQL scripting, automation, monitoring, and observability tools to improve
operational resilience, service health, reliability, and incident response.

* Excellent SQL scripting skills.

Python or VBScript.

intelligent automation capabilities to reduce manual effort, improve
operational efficiency, and enhance incident response workflows.

anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, and service optimisation.

reduction, and continuous service improvement.

operational tasks.

Splunk, Grafana, Cloudprober, and Moogsoft.

* Experience of recovering priority incidents with limited support and
operating effectively under pressure.
* Experience building and maintaining automated runbooks and operational
tooling to support application recovery, health checks, and environment
validation.

or Microsoft MQ.
* Knowledge of issue and problem tracking systems such as ServiceNow.
* Demonstrated ability to improve operational resilience through automation,
scripting, and reliability engineering best practices.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrates the right attitude towards the role and is willing to support
all products and respond to live problems with the highest priority.

support teams, with a proven ability to liaise and coordinate across
disparate and multi-disciplined teams.
* Maintains a high level of professionalism when communicating with external
clients and internal users to resolve problems.
* Takes ownership of issues and strives to bring them to closure while managing
expectations effectively.

We’ll give you the time, support and opportunities to build your security engineering skills and develop the confidence to contribute to challenging client projects. Curiosity, a careful and structured approach to problem solving, and enthusiasm for technology are more important than having experience in every area of cyber security.

## 

### **Overview**

Cambridge Consultants develops deep technology across sensing, communications, embedded systems, artificial intelligence and complex systems. Our Trusted AI and Secure Technologies team helps clients understand, design and demonstrate security and trustworthiness in emerging and connected technologies.

You’ll work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside engineers and specialists in electronics, firmware, software, RF, AI and data science, and systems engineering. Projects can span the full engineering lifecycle, from early-stage concepts and requirements through to implementation, verification, deployment and in-service support.

Our work includes cyber security, secure-by-design engineering, embedded and connected systems, industrial and critical infrastructure, defence and national security, edge AI, secure connectivity and post-quantum cryptography.

You’ll work on real client assignments with support and guidance from experienced engineers. You’ll have opportunities to contribute across different stages of the engineering lifecycle and work alongside specialists from across Cambridge Consultants.

You may contribute to projects at different stages of the engineering lifecycle, from early-stage concept development and requirements through to architecture, implementation, verification, deployment and in-service support.

* Supporting vulnerability assessments and security testing, including helping to scope testing activities and track remediation.
* Investigating vulnerabilities and helping teams understand and address security risks.
* Contributing to security cases, assurance activities and technical documentation.
* Analysing systems, software and technical designs to identify potential security weaknesses.
* Developing prototypes, analysis tools or other technical solutions to investigate security problems.
* Working with multidisciplinary teams to understand the interaction between security, functionality, safety and system performance.
* Communicating technical findings clearly to engineers, project teams and customers.

##### **Domains and project types**

You could work across a range of applications and technologies, including:

* **Critical national infrastructure:** energy, transport, communications and utilities.
* **Industrial systems:** ICS, SCADA, OT and industrial IoT.
* **Defence and national security:** secure systems and technologies supporting demanding operational environments.
* **Emerging technologies:** AI assurance, sensing, secure connectivity and post-quantum cryptography.

### **What you can bring**

* An excellent degree or PhD in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Electronic/Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics or a related technical discipline.
* 12 months industrial experience, for example through a placement year or relevant postgraduate experience.
* A good understanding of fundamental engineering, computing or security principles.

* + cyber/security engineering
  + software or application development
  + embedded systems
  + computer or network systems
  + electronics or hardware security
  + AI or data science
  + systems engineering

* The ability to understand and analyse technical systems and identify risks or weaknesses.
* Some familiarity with security concepts such as authentication, authorisation, cryptography, key management, secure boot, network security and secure development.
* The ability to read and understand code in languages such as C, C++, Python or Java.
* Enthusiasm for learning and developing new technical skills.
* A careful and structured approach to problem solving.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with others.

##### **The below is advantageous, but isn’t essential**

* Familiarity with threat-modelling approaches such as STRIDE or MITRE ATT&CK.
* Knowledge of secure development practices and frameworks such as OWASP or CWE.
* Experience with embedded platforms, MCUs, RTOS, TPMs or TrustZone.
* Familiarity with industrial protocols and standards such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA or IEC 62443.
* Experience using tools such as Burp Suite, Wireshark or firmware-analysis tools.
* An understanding of cloud security.
* Experience considering security alongside safety or other system-level requirements.
* Security research, university projects, technical projects or open-source contributions.
* Industry certifications or formal security training.

Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria.

• Practical experience in a SOC, incident response, security monitoring, detection engineering or a closely related technical security role.

• Ability to document investigations clearly, maintain evidence and explain findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Good understanding of common attacker techniques, phishing, account compromise, malware, vulnerabilities and cloud security risks.

• Ability to prioritise effectively and collaborate across operational teams.

• A careful, curious and evidence-led approach, with strong attention to detail and sound judgement.

• Willingness to participate in the paid out-of-hours on-call rota.  
Desirable skills and experience

• Threat hunting, detection-rule development, alert tuning, malware analysis or digital forensics experience.

• Knowledge of vulnerability and exposure management, penetration-testing remediation and security-control assurance.

• Knowledge of ISO 27001/27002, Cyber Essentials Plus, MITRE ATT&CK or comparable security frameworks.
