## **What is the role?**

Head of Data Protection Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance shall lead the Data Protection Function that is responsible for developing, implementing, embedding and maintaining a data protection control and oversight framework for Howden’s UK Broking (including its Specialty and Retail Pillars) and UK Reinsurance Divisions. The framework must be pragmatic, risk based and suitably robust to support Howden’s UK Broking and UK Reinsurance entities to meet applicable data protection legislation, including the UK Data Protection Act, but also any other applicable legislation in territories where those entities operate. The framework must also align to and complement Howden Group’s overarching Data Protection framework, governance and policy.

## 

## **What will you be doing?**

### ***Oversight & Change***

* Work closely with Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance senior leadership to develop and drive a data protection strategy that is aligned to the operating model and strategies of those businesses, promoting and supporting consistency of approach and application as much as practically possible.
* Develop and maintain an annual Data Protection Plan setting out the resources needed to deliver the projects and activities to be undertaken by the function, which shall be aligned to and support the regulatory expectations and objectives of the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses (which may include their overseas operations).
* Support in developing and maintaining a data protection risk and control framework, including data protection policy, processes, procedures, controls and monitoring.
* Implementing a data protection horizon scanning process, ensuring any new or changing legislation is identified and implemented by expected timeframes.
* Produce reports and escalate data protection updates, risks, issues and compliance performance to the relevant Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance governance committees.
* Establish and maintain an effective data protection risk identification and escalation process across all Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses, ensuring swift and timely mitigation or management of risks and breaches.
* Develop, maintain and promote the consistent use of data protection tooling.
* Continually raise awareness of data protection and ensure adequate programme of data protection related training to employees.
* Oversee and manage any reporting to and interaction with data protection supervisory authorities, including the Information Commissioner’s Office.
* Ensure that all Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses have the correct data protection registrations and licences.
* Support in embedding a data protection by design approach within Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses.

### ***Stakeholders***

### Develop and maintain appropriate working relationships with the following to ensure that data protection issues are identified and proactive provision of appropriate solutions:

* Key senior leadership across the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses to ensure a strong understanding of their current and future strategies, business models and objectives, to proactively pre-empt and recognise the data protection support they will require.
* Key operational and functional heads that are responsible for the development and delivery of operational processes and systems to embed a data protection by design approach and to support swift escalation of risks and concerns.
* Key information security leadership and functions, to ensure a clear understanding of information security processes and controls, and how these dovetail and work alongside data protection controls and risk mitigants.
* Internal Control Function Heads across the first, second and third line of defence, to develop an aligned and complementary risk, control and assurance framework, and to support addressing remedial actions.
* Group Head of Data Protection and wider group data protection functions to support an alignment of approach, ensure consistent upward escalation and reporting and to share best practice and common risks and issues.

  

### 

### ***Function responsibilities***

To develop, support and maintain a data protection function that is able to achieve the following for Howden’s UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses.

* Providing timely and considered advice and guidance on a range of data protection matters relating to Howden’s UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses, this will include, but will not be limited to – Marketing, DPIA’s, Subject Rights, Privacy Notices, Data Security.
* Supporting compliance with the UK Data Protection Act, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), other Data Protection Laws and the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR).
* Establish processes to monitoring compliance with the EU GDPR and other data protection laws, such as the UK Data Protection Act 2018, our data protection policies, including internal data protection activities, raising awareness of data protection issues, training staff;
* Providing advice on the conduct of and supervising data protection impact assessments (DPIAs);
* Completing a Record of Processing Activities (ROPA) that cover each of the in scope entities within Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance.
* Complete annual Data Protection Risk Assessments for Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance, ensuring that these are reported to the relevant governing committees, but that they also support and contribute to wider Howden Group Data Protection Risk Assessments and ERICCA.
* Support in the development and on-going reporting of KRI and KCIs that feed into the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance risk management framework and, where relevant, Howden Group risk management framework and ERICCA.
* Having regard to the risk associated with processing operations and taking account of the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing
* Prioritising focus on the more risky activities, e.g. where special category (sensitive) personal data is processed, or where the potential impact on individuals could be damaging;
* Establishing clear points of contact for all BAU data protection queries from Howden’s UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses with regard to potential complaints and breaches, ensuring that data subject rights’ requests accurately handled
* Making available data protection resources, policies, procedures, guidance, training material and points of contact information in a way that is easily accessible.

  

### ***Team management***

* Develop and maintain a function with the appropriate blend of skill, experience and knowledge to deliver the data protection support and oversight required by the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses.
* Implement an approach to employee development which enables employees to enhance their data protection, industry and Howden knowledge, experience and skill set.
* Provides visionary leadership by fostering a culture of employee engagement and role modelling, encouraging and rewarding essential behaviours and maintaining a high level of personal and professional confidence
* Manages (resource, motivate, drive, develop and focus) the team to ensure the required standards of performance are met; and that the professional and personal development of all team members increases their capability and effectiveness
* Promotes individual accountability through an ongoing performance management approach that aligns personal performance goals with the functional and wider business goals
* Ensures there are effective succession plans in place and actively develops team members to provide future successors
* Identifies and hires talent
* Manage (resource, motivate, drive, develop and focus) the UK data Protection Function to ensure the required standards of performance are met; and that the professional and personal development of all team members increases their capability and effectiveness
* Actively undertakes personal development to ensure up to date knowledge and understanding of best practice

* Key senior leadership across the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses to ensure a strong understanding of their current and future strategies, business models and objectives, to proactively pre-empt and recognise the data protection support they will require.

* Group Head of Data Protection and wider group data protection functions to support an alignment of approach, ensure consistent upward escalation and reporting and to share best practice and common risks and issues.

* Ability to provide risk-based advice.
* Experience in achieving stated objectives involving a diverse set of business partners and leading multifaceted projects.
* Negotiation skills to work effectively with key internal and external partners.
* Client relationship skills to continuously coordinate with controllers and processors while maintaining independence.
* Interpersonal skills to communicate well with a wide-ranging audience, from the Board of Directors to data subjects, from managers to IT staff and lawyers.
* Self-starter with ability to gain required knowledge in wide-ranging environments.
* Experienced within a Data Protection compliance field, to include building, implementing and managing data protection programmes within a sophisticated and enterprise-wide organisation.
* Experience with supporting marketing initiatives and the PECR regulations.
* Experience in handling data subject rights requests.
* Detailed knowledge of UK and European data protection law, and an in-depth knowledge of the GDPR.
* An understanding of technical and operational measures that should be in place to ensure the security of personal data and familiarity with information technologies and data security.
* Experience in compliance monitoring and risk management.
* Experienced in producing and presenting data protection reports to senior governance committees.
* Experienced in developing and delivering data protection training to employees of all levels.
* Financial Services experience preferred.

* Compliance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), UK Data Protection Act 2018, other UK data protection / privacy related legislation (such as the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations) and ICO guidance related to the tasks of a DPO.

### **Professional Qualifications**

# Senior Quantum Physicist

Oxford, England, United Kingdom

**About IonQ:**

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.  
  
Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

**Location:** This role is based at our Oxford, UK office with the option to work a few days a week remotely.  
**Travel:** Up to 5% **Job ID:** 1777

**The Role:**

We are pioneering advancements in quantum computing by utilizing trapped ion technology and our proprietary laser-free quantum control methods. Our research and development efforts build on our fully integrated quantum processors that can be fabricated within standard silicon foundries. This unique approach allows us to leverage the highest-performing qubit technology while ensuring scalability and manufacturability using existing semiconductor fabrication technology. We approach quantum computing with a focus on minimizing errors, striving to achieve ultra-low gate errors at scale. Our immediate objective is to develop functional quantum computers within the NISQ regime, aiming to construct fault-tolerant machines that require minimal QEC overhead. Our recent breakthroughs include achieving 99.97% fidelity in two-qubit gates and 99.9992% fidelity in single-qubit operations without error correction, setting new industry standards for performance.

We are looking for Quantum Physicist to join our UK Science team at IonQ. Our Quantum Scientists work at the forefront of our research efforts to develop the next generation of quantum computers.

They are responsible for validating and optimising the performance of our computers, playing a critical role in ensuring we are able to meet our research and development goals and timelines. Our Scientists’ work spans a broad range of areas from designing, coding, debugging and executing experiments, to developing and validating novel control schemes. They are responsible for documenting and sharing their findings with the aim of pushing the boundaries of system performance.

**Responsibilities:**

As a Senior Quantum Scientist, you will typically be responsible for a combination of these different responsibilities:

* Prototyping and characterising coherent control and cooling schemes for trapped-ion qubits using laser and microwave fields.
* Calibrating and benchmarking quantum systems, focusing on achieving the highest fidelities for quantum circuit primitives (e.g. ion transport or gate operations) and full circuits.
* Validating emerging trap technologies, including integrated electronics and photonics for large-scale architectures.
* Analysing experimental data, debug complex hardware/software interactions, and ensure reliability of qubit operations.

**Requirements:**

To be successful in this role, you will need a PhD in physics or a related discipline, with a strong foundation in atomic or qubit-related physics. Prior postdoctoral or industry experience is valuable, but we are open to applicants moving directly from a PhD.

We’re looking for someone with a solid background in quantum control, and hands-on experience in calibration, benchmarking, or coherent control of qubits, would be desirable. We’re looking for motivated scientists who can contribute to the progress of this fast moving, highly technical team and help the organisation meet our research goals.

You’d be a great fit with:

* Proven expertise in experimental AMO physics or quantum computing. Experience with trapped ions is beneficial though not essential.
* Prior experience in one or more of the following: spectroscopy or coherent control of multi-level systems, characterisation of control hardware, gate fidelity benchmarking or running quantum circuits on hardware.
* Strong proficiency in programming and data analysis, experience of Python or Rust is desirable.
* Strong collaborative skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a fast-moving team.
* A track record of scientific communication through publications, talks and conferences would be advantageous.

**Benefits:**

Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing.

We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more.

Join us and be part of the future of quantum computing.

As technical lead, the role requires strong hands-on expertise across areas of evidence synthesis such as feasibility assessments, direct and indirect treatment comparisons, population-adjustment (MAIC, STC, ML-NMR), surrogate endpoint evaluation, structured expert elicitation, survival analyses, external comparator arms etc. Besides working in integrated teams across geographies and functions, a key part of the role is to build and maintain effective client relationships to add value in a rapidly evolving environment.

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE**  
In-depth expertise and hands-on experience with advanced evidence synthesis methods is essential. The role requires a good understanding of the health care sector and the pharmaceutical market, as well as general consulting methodologies and business practices. Experience in the delivery of consulting engagements is desirable.  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Client engagements

* Lead day-to-day activities of multiple evidence synthesis projects with the support of junior team members, including the development of statistical analysis protocols (SAP) and conduct of feasibility assessments, evidence synthesis by means of meta-analysis, indirect treatment comparison or network meta-analysis (frequentist or Bayesian) with patient-level and/or aggregate data from RCTs
* Provide senior technical and statistical leadership and effective ad hoc problem-solving support to the delivery of diverse evidence synthesis projects
* Edit, review, and develop scripts to ensure accurate and efficient implementation tailored to specific research problems. Full proficiency and demonstrable coding/programming experience in WinBUGS, OpenBUGS, JAGS and R is required, and knowledge of Stan is desirable
* Provide technical guidance, input and quality control for key deliverables (e.g., draft protocols, statistical analysis plans, reports, manuscripts)
* Support project implementation including overall project management and client engagement

Business development

* Conceptualize evidence synthesis engagements in response to client request for proposals
* Contribute to business development; build and maintain effective client relationships

Driving development

* Establish research credentials and further the wider IQVIA profile in evidence synthesis through the development of innovative methods and the dissemination of research outputs in peer-reviewed journals and scientific conferences
* Support the development of product offerings and internal process optimization as part of the Centre of Excellence for Indirect Treatment Comparisons

Mentoring

* Coaching and training for junior statisticians and project delivery teams
* Serve as a line manager for junior staff members

**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, TECHNICAL AND PERSONAL SKILLLS**  
  
Essential qualifications

* Master’s degree in (medical) statistics, biostatistics, mathematics, epidemiology, public health, health economics or related discipline
* PhD in a subject related to health services research or statistics is desirable

Essential skills, knowledge and personal behaviours

* At least 5 years prior relevant experience working as a statistician in consultancy, CRO, pharmaceutical/biotech or academia (as post-graduate researcher)
* Strong quantitative skills and experience with Bayesian statistics, generalized linear models, feasibility assessments, direct and indirect treatment comparisons (ITCs), population-adjustment (MAIC, STC, ML-NMR), surrogate endpoint evaluation, structured expert elicitation, survival analyses

* Experience developing tools or automating processes used in ITCs or broader statistical workflows in HTA, preferably in R, Stan or any other relevant programming language.
* Experience in clinical comparison across the evidence base (e.g., assessment of cross-trial heterogeneity in populations, interventions, outcomes and study design) and hands-on familiarity with tools to assess the quality and risk of bias of the included evidence (e.g., RoB-2, ROBINS-I, GRADE, AMSTAR-2)

**Working at Westminster**

Westminster School is a busy, purposeful and vibrant place to be and an excellent workplace. The community is made up of around 750 pupils, 120 teaching staff and 108 support staff.

Our staff are friendly and welcoming, and all newcomers quickly become part of the rhythm of life here.

There is a real sense of community here as, being a boarding school many members of staff and pupils live on site and the School’s premises are very much treated as a home away from home. School life starts before breakfast and continues way beyond the working day; as a result, there is always a lively atmosphere in and around School and always someone to share a tea and biscuit with in the Common Room. Support staff as much as teaching staff are encouraged to embrace the School’s day-to-day activities, whether that be attending an evening concert or a morning service in the Abbey.

At Westminster we will always select the best candidate for every position. We do know, however, that we can only truly choose the best person on every occasion if a broad and diverse pool of candidates see the job advertised and are encouraged to apply.

As such, we continue to work on how our job roles are encountered, and particularly welcome applications from groups who have traditionally been underrepresented here.

Westminster School is for everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation or any other protected characteristic. We hope you are encouraged to apply.

**The School**

Westminster School is an independent day and boarding school for boys aged 13-18 and girls aged 16-18, with a long history, a distinctive ethos, and a unique sense of place in the very heart of London. Pupils achieve exceptional examination results and entrance to some of the top universities in the world. It is a busy, passionate and purposeful place where independent and deep thinking is enjoyed, encouraged and respected by all, and where holistic excellence is nurtured and valued.

While the School is one of the foremost centres of academic excellence in the country, its commitment to academic life does not make it a hothouse for passing examinations. Pupils’ success at examinations and entry to leading universities is instead a result of their enjoyment of academic enquiry, debate and search for explanation, well beyond published syllabuses. Pupils are intellectually, socially, ethically and politically engaged and our aim is to ensure that their enthusiasm for learning is developed further, allowing them to take full advantage of the opportunities presented to them in the future. At Westminster, pupils have the freedom to lead on projects outside of the classroom and embrace a whole range of extra-curricular activities and interests. A host of pupil-led societies take place every week at the School, often with expert guest speakers, and pupils can choose to study an additional language, play an instrument or two, volunteer in local primary schools, row along the Thames, take part in plays and musicals, and much more.

The School’s ethos resides in the enduring values of the liberal tradition reflected in the 1560 Charter of Westminster’s Elizabethan foundation, where it is stated that: ‘the youth which is growing to manhood, as tender shoots in the wood of our state, shall be liberally instructed in good books to the greater honour of the state’. Whilst academic and cultural attainments are highly prized at Westminster, the School is fully committed also to each pupil’s spiritual, moral, emotional and physical development and wellbeing – with a particular emphasis on drawing out individual talent wherever it lies – and to prepare young people for fulfilled private and public lives.

From September 2028, the School will welcome both girls and boys at 13+ entry, offering a Westminster education to all. By 2026, Westminster Under School will have opened its brand new pre-prep for girls and boys at 4+ and girls will have joined boys in Years 3 and 7, at the 7+ and 11+ entry points. By 2030, all year groups at Westminster School and Westminster Under School, from ages four to 18, will be fully co-educational, reflecting the School’s dedication to inclusivity and excellence.

* Oxfordshire
* Headington Oxford
* Full-time

#### Summary

This is a varied, hands-on management role supporting the safe, secure and effective day-to-day operation of the School.

#### Detail

This is a varied, hands-on management role supporting the safe, secure and effective day-to-day operation of the School. The postholder will provide flexible operational support across the School, including coordinating site security arrangement and managing the transport fleet. The role also assists the Director of Operations with risk management, health and safety and compliance, including the standards and evidence relevant to an independent school.

Alongside the operational remit, the postholder will act as the CCF School Staff Instructor for approximately two days per week during term time. The SSI is central to the efficient administration, safe delivery and development of the CCF Contingent and will support planned evening and weekend activities, exercises and camps.

To be successful in this role, you will hold a full, clean UK driving licence and possess—or be willing to obtain—appropriate CCF weapon handling/range and first-aid qualifications. You will bring substantial experience from a military, cadet force, or uniformed youth organization background, giving you the credibility to train cadets and support adult volunteers. Alongside strong administrative, fleet, and stores discipline, you must demonstrate a sound understanding of health and safety, risk assessment, and MoD assurance requirements. Excellent communication and problem-solving skills are essential, as is the flexibility to work occasional evenings, weekends, and week-long camps, plus participation in an agreed emergency call-out rota.

Headington School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. Applicants must be able to provide evidence of having the right to live and work in the UK and must undergo child protection screening, including checks with past employers and DBS and barred lists checks. The School expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. Headington School is an equal opportunities employer.

**We’re looking for a Technical Recruiter.**

You'll hire exceptional people and help build high-performing engineering, data science, and product teams – shaping hiring decisions with data and collaborating on our tech hiring strategy.

**The company**

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

**The team**

The Tech Talent team hires for iwoca's Tech, Analytics, and Product (TAP) functions – we own the briefs, the sourcing, the assessment, and the standards. We're a team of three, part of a broader talent team of eight, hiring across TAP (around 200 people and growing). Heads of Engineering, Data, and Product rely on us to shape hiring direction, and our work directly impacts the teams who build our products, systems, and customer experience.

We focus on high-calibre talent – people who raise the bar and improve the teams they join. Data and structure keep our hiring objective and measured, and we share knowledge and challenge each other's thinking to raise standards.

We use Ashby as our ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter and Welcome to the Jungle for sourcing, and several tech-specific job boards for advertising, with Claude as our main AI tool.

**The role**

As a Technical Recruiter, you'll focus on engineering, data science, and product roles through discovery, calibration, and execution. You'll solve hiring problems from first principles, with reasoning that is defensible.

* **Discovery and judgement.** You'll shape role briefs with hiring managers, weighing trade-offs between seniority, scope, skill mix, and what the market will realistically supply. You'll change the process when it doesn't match the role.
* **Sourcing and candidate standards.** You'll run outbound sourcing across software engineering, data science, strategy and product, mapping the market and designing outreach that candidates actually reply to. You'll calibrate what good looks like in panel debriefs, and tune the candidate experience to the role.
* **Scale and measurement.** You'll run a feedback loop on your own work – scoring recommendations against frameworks, tracking passthrough rates, and calibrating against downstream interviewer feedback. Each cycle sharpens your judgement. You'll build the workflows and prompts that scale you and the team, and keep Ashby accurate so colleagues can self-serve pipeline data.
* **Experimentation and improvement.** You'll experiment with hiring methods – AI tools, outreach formats, job description iterations – and judge what's worth adopting. You'll balance this with delivering your roles.
* **Autonomy and growth.** You'll run your roles end-to-end from day one, with the expectation of growing into a domain expert – defining what good looks like, developing hiring strategy, and advising stakeholders on high-impact decisions.

**The requirements**

Essential:

* **Technical hiring.** You've recruited software engineers, and you can assess engineering CVs on specialism, seniority, credibility, and relevance.
* **Sourcing.** You’ve run outbound sourcing campaigns. You build market maps, test outreach approaches, and reach candidates who wouldn't apply directly.
* **Judgement.** You prioritise where you spend your time – which candidates, which roles, which methods. You adjust to new evidence, and you can explain your reasoning clearly.
* **Make stuff happen.** You take initiative, keep it moving, and have a bias for action.
* **Communication.** You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You explain complex trade-offs in plain terms.
* **Technical fluency.** You treat tools and systems as figure-out-able, and pick up new tech fast. You use AI and judge its output critically.

Bonus:

* **Analytical mindset.** You think systematically and methodically. You gather data, seek feedback, and adapt to new evidence.
* **Data science hiring.** You've hired data scientists working on applied machine learning; probabilistic models for decision-making.
* **Product or strategy hiring.** You've hired for product or strategy roles in tech companies where analytical thinking is central.
* **Privacy standards.** You understand candidate data standards – GDPR, data minimisation, handling personal data. You treat candidate information as sensitive by default.

**The salary**

We expect to pay from £50,000 to £70,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

**The culture**

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

**The offices**

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

* Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.
* Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

**The benefits**

* Flexible working hours.
* Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.
* A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.
* 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.
* A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.
* Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.
* 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.
* An employee equity incentive scheme.
* Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.
* Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.
* Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

job_description:
## About this role

You're a designer who has facilitated workshops or built online courses, and you noticed that **you loved it and that you were unusually good at it**.

You know how to make complex skills easy to learn, and how to guide people in applying their new skills. As one of our Education Designers, you'll structure and create the courses and Master Classes you lead.

You've taught design or AI to hundreds of people. Now you get the opportunity to **teach it to hundreds of thousands** of learners around the world.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes include **[REDACTED] and [REDACTED]**, as well as Design Leads at **[REDACTED], [REDACTED], [REDACTED], and [REDACTED]**. [REDACTED] also chairs our executive board.

You’ll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you to **take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow**. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

## Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

[REDACTED] is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like [REDACTED], NASA, and [REDACTED], who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us **take online education to new heights** and **make a meaningful impact on humankind**.

At [REDACTED], we’re not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

## We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

* **Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:** lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there. **This is the role described here.**
* **Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:** lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our **Education Designers**.
* **Our Course Writers and Editors:** lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the user’s perspective.

We’re a flexible team, and you’ll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

**You, the Education Designer,** establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course. You create the sequences, exercises, templates, and assessments. You'll work closely with our **Co-Founder**, your **Team Lead**, and the **Course Directors**, who lead on what we teach and who teaches it, and you'll have a real say in both. We all reach out to and collaborate with industry leaders in these processes. Once your course is ready, our **Course Writers and Editors** take it the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

## Your Role at [REDACTED]

* **Be a core part of our Editorial Team.** You'll collaborate with [REDACTED] editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.
* **Design for a diverse, global audience.** Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, you'll teach both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.
* **Make an impact as you decide how the courses you lead come together.** You establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course, then you plan, structure, and create the core content that gets them there. What comes first, what builds on what, and how people level up step by step with ease and joy from confused to competent. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.
* Design the exercises, portfolio activities, design templates, and assessments that **turn passive watching into active designing**. You write the exercises that make a course participant apply an idea to their own portfolio project, the templates that scaffold that work, and the assessments that reveal whether they understood and can apply it, or whether they just watched. You write the headings and hooks your structure calls for, and our Course Writers and Editors own the final wording. Every course should leave a participant with a portfolio case study they can show a hiring manager.
* **Set and raise the standard for our assessments,** so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests.
* **Make expert knowledge understandable.** You take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches timeless human-centered design and AI.
* **You help produce Master Classes.** We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session. **Timelines vary enormously**: with [REDACTED] or [REDACTED] it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Course Directors and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.
* You **plan the course content in collaboration with the global industry leaders** in design and then **fly out to meet them in professional studios across the world**. You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On average **we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.**
* **Our courses combine written and video lessons.** You'll work closely with the video team, giving constructive feedback on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective. You'll also work closely with our growth team.
* **Balance the big picture with the smaller details.** Expect to focus on **one large course creation project per quarter**, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published.

* **Be a core part of our Editorial Team.** You'll collaborate with [REDACTED] editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to **create educational content for people worldwide**. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills in **timeless, human-centered design and AI**.
* **Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds.** The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure.
* **You don't need a design background.** Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. * **Write for a diverse, global audience.** Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.
* **Be the voice of [REDACTED].** Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours. **Represent a global movement dedicated to design education**, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.

# B2B Sales & Marketing Coordinator

We usually respond within three days

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We’re looking for an organised, commercially minded and proactive B2B Sales & Marketing Coordinator to join our Wholesale team, supporting the continued growth of our B2B business across our four global brands: Joma Jewellery, A Littles & Co, Katie Loxton and Katie Loxton Inc.

Working closely with our B2B Sales & Marketing Manager and wider commercial team, you’ll play a key role in coordinating day-to-day B2B marketing activity, supporting sales operations and helping us maximise opportunities across our wholesale channels.

You will make an impact by coordinating B2B sales and marketing activity across our global brands and territories, supporting new season launches, campaigns and promotions, and ensuring our sales channels and customer-facing platforms remain accurate and up to date. You’ll also support our Sales Agent network with day-to-day queries, reporting, prospecting and sales administration, helping to identify and maximise opportunities for commercial growth.

Acting as a central point of communication across Sales, Marketing, Creative, Customer Experience, Operations and Events, you’ll help ensure activity is aligned and delivered smoothly. This is a great opportunity for someone with experience in sales, marketing or commercial coordination who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is looking to develop their career within a growing global fashion and lifestyle business.

The role is Monday - Friday 9am-5pm. You'll enjoy the exciting buzz of our friendly office in Banbury, Oxfordshire three times a week on average with the flexibility to work from home for the remaining two days. This may increase to 5 days a week during peak periods.

**BEHIND THE BRANDS**

We’re a family-run, entrepreneurial company with an exciting pace of life and a bright and friendly team. We are passionate about creating stunning products with a personal touch and innovating our business behind the scenes. We value creativity, collaboration and integrity. 

**HOW YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE**

* Supporting the B2B Sales & Marketing Manager and wider Wholesale team to drive commercial growth, strengthen Sales Agent performance and maximise opportunities to achieve and exceed agreed sales targets.
* Coordinating and executing the B2B marketing calendar across all territories, ensuring activity is aligned with the wider wholesale strategy and commercial objectives.
* Supporting the delivery of new season launches, coordinating sales tools including brochures, training materials, creative assets, emails, app content and website updates.
* Coordinating B2B email marketing campaigns, ensuring content is accurate, engaging and delivered on schedule.
* Monitoring and maintaining the B2B sales app, ensuring product categories, collections, pricing, imagery and stock availability are accurate and up to date.
* Maintaining and regularly auditing B2B websites, ensuring product listings, seasonal campaigns and category pages are accurate and complete.
* Partnering with the Customer Experience team to support Sales Agents with day-to-day queries and ensure prompt resolution.
* Assisting with reporting and analysing sales performance, campaign results, customer engagement and website activity to identify opportunities for improvement and growth.
* Identifying new wholesale marketing opportunities and initiatives to support sales growth, including reviewing new stockist enquiries before sharing with Sales Agents.
* Monitoring competitor activity, industry trends and customer feedback, sharing relevant insights and opportunities with the wider team.
* Ensuring sales and marketing information remains accurate and consistent across internal systems and customer-facing platforms, applying appropriate regional spelling, terminology and product information.
* Coordinating trade press advertising briefs, including supporting additional editorial opportunities and features.
* Supporting the Wholesale and Events teams with sales and marketing requirements for owned stores and external stockists, including imagery, assets, showroom presentations, events and invitations.
* Building strong working relationships across Sales, Marketing, Creative, Operations, Customer Experience and the Sales Agent network to support effective communication and delivery of commercial objectives.
* Providing sales administration support across the UK and EU Sales Agent network, including sales performance and gaps reporting, prospecting support, new stockist enquiries and showroom coordination.
* Undertaking additional projects and responsibilities to support the continued growth of the wholesale channel.

 

**THE TALENT YOU'LL BRING**

* Previous experience within a B2B Sales, Marketing or Commercial Coordinator/Assistant role.
* A strong understanding of sales processes and marketing principles, with good commercial awareness.
* Experience maintaining product information and data, ideally across customer-facing sales or ecommerce platforms.
* Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail, particularly when working with product information, pricing and written content.
* Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively across multiple teams and external partners.
* A proactive and solutions-focused approach, with the confidence to take ownership and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel; experience with CRM, ERP or sales management systems would be advantageous.
* Experience within the fashion, lifestyle or jewellery industry would be desirable but isn't essential.
* A highly motivated, collaborative and positive can-do attitude, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

**PERFECTLY PACKAGED**

* A salary of up to £32,000
* 33 days holiday including bank holidays rising to 35 with length of service
* A broad benefits package including our staff favourite – a very generous staff discount across both our brands. See all of our benefits on our careers portal
* Opportunities to make an impact as well as learn and develop further
* An innovative and friendly workplace with a team we’re proud to be part of. Find out more about us and our culture on our careers portal

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We’re excited to be recruiting for a Senior Ecommerce Trading Manager to take overall ownership of the commercial performance and trading strategy for Joma Jewellery’s digital business. This is a fantastic opportunity to play a key role in shaping how Joma Jewellery trades and grows through its digital channel.

You’ll own online sales performance, ensuring the website delivers against its commercial targets. You’ll turn commercial and customer insight into clear trading actions, using performance data and market opportunities to optimise the online customer journey and maximise sales. You’ll use commercial judgement to set priorities, identify opportunities for growth and balance short-term trading performance with longer-term commercial objectives.

You’ll also own the Joma Jewellery trading calendar, translating the brand, product and commercial strategy into a clear digital trading plan. You’ll ensure product launches, campaigns, promotions and key gifting moments are planned and delivered effectively, with every opportunity optimised to achieve its full commercial potential.

Working closely with Marketing, Merchandising, Product, Creative, UX and Development, you’ll bring teams together around clear commercial priorities and influence cross-functional decision making. You’ll ensure activity delivers a seamless, inspiring and commercially effective customer experience.

You’ll thrive in this role if you’re commercially focused, analytical and able to turn insight into clear actions and priorities. You’ll enjoy using performance data and market opportunities to identify areas for growth and applying commercial judgement to optimise trading performance. Most importantly, you’ll be excited by the opportunity to take ownership of Joma Jewellery’s digital trading strategy and play a key role in shaping how the brand trades and grows through its digital channel.

This role is Monday to Friday, 9am–5pm. You'll enjoy the exciting buzz of our stunning Head Office in Banbury, Oxfordshire, spending an average of three days a week with the team, alongside the flexibility to work from home for the remaining days.

**BEHIND THE BRANDS**

We’re a family-run, entrepreneurial company with an exciting pace of life and a bright and friendly team. We are passionate about creating stunning products with a personal touch and innovating our business behind the scenes. We value creativity, collaboration and integrity.

**HOW YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE**

**Commercial Trading**

* Own the day to day trading performance of the Joma Jewellery website
* Deliver revenue, conversion, average order value and product performance targets
* Monitor performance daily and identify the actions required to address risks or maximise opportunities.
* Lead weekly trade reporting, clearly communicating performance, key drivers, risks and recommended actions.
* Build and manage the ecommerce trading calendar across launches, campaigns, promotions and gifting occasions.
* Ensure activity is supported by clear commercial targets, product priorities and success measures
* Review performance following launches and campaigns, translating results into future improvements

**Product and Onsite Trading**

* Build compelling product stories and customer journeys across the homepage, navigation, landing pages, product listing pages and product detail pages
* Ensure the right products are given the right level of visibility based on stock, margin, demand, campaigns and customer relevance.
* Partner with Merchandising to manage availability, product opportunities, stock risks and sell through
* Oversee onsite visual merchandising, product sequencing, recommendations, cross selling and category presentation
* Ensure new products are launched accurately, on time and with strong commercial support
* Maximise opportunities across gifting, personalisation, promotion and other strategic product initiatives.
* Maintain high standards of website accuracy, including pricing, promotions, product information and customer messaging

**Customer and Conversion**

* Use customer, behavioural and trading data to understand how customers are shopping and where performance can be improved
* Identify opportunities to improve conversion, product discovery, attachment rate, average order value and repeat purchase.
* Work with UX and Development to prioritise improvements to the customer journey
* Support the ecommerce testing roadmap, developing clear hypotheses and measuring the commercial impact of changes
* Use tools including GA4, ContentSquare and customer insight platforms to identify customer pain points and opportunities
* Ensure the onsite experience reflects the Joma Jewellery brand and makes shopping and gifting simple, inspiring and intuitive

**Campaigns and Newness**

* Translate the brand and product calendar into a clear digital trading plan
* Partner with Marketing and Creative to ensure campaigns are commercially effective and delivered consistently across channels
* Develop strong launch plans for new collections, product drops and seasonal moments
* Define hero products, supporting products onsite journeys for each launch
* Ensure marketing traffic lands on relevant, optimised and commercially effective customer journeys

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* Manage and develop the Ecommerce Visual Merchandiser, setting clear priorities and standards
* Provide clear briefs, deadlines and commercial context to cross-functional teams
* Build strong working relationships across Ecommerce, Merchandising, Marketing, CRM, Product, Creative, Customer Service and Operations
* Represent Joma Jewellery’s ecommerce priorities in trade, campaign and product planning meeting
* Encourage a customer focused, data led and action oriented approach to trading

**THE TALENT YOU'LL BRING**

* Proven experience leading ecommerce trading within a product-led retail business, ideally across jewellery, fashion, accessories, gifting or a similar category.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience owning sales performance and making decisions that drive revenue, conversion, margin and customer value.
* A track record of developing and delivering ecommerce trading strategies that support wider business and brand objectives.
* Strong knowledge of onsite merchandising, customer journeys, conversion optimisation and digital trading, with Magento experience advantageous.
* Highly analytical, with the ability to interpret trading, customer and market data and turn insight into clear commercial priorities and action.
* Experience using analytics and behavioural insight tools such as GA4 and ContentSquare to identify opportunities and diagnose performance.
* Experience owning an ecommerce trading calendar across product launches, campaigns, promotions and key seasonal or gifting moments.
* A strong understanding of customer behaviour, market trends and competitor activity, with a natural eye for spotting opportunities for growth.
* Commercially minded and comfortable balancing immediate trading performance with longer-term opportunities and strategic priorities.
* A confident influencer who can build alignment across teams, challenge constructively and communicate commercial priorities clearly.
* Strong leadership skills, with experience managing, coaching and developing others and creating a high-performance, commercially focused team environment.
* An excellent communicator who can confidently articulate performance, opportunities, risks and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple launches, deadlines and priorities in a fast-paced trading environment.
* Proactive, solutions-focused and accountable, with a genuine sense of ownership for delivering results.
* Customer-focused, with a strong understanding of how brand, customer experience and commercial performance come together to create a great digital experience.
* Collaborative by nature, with experience working across Ecommerce, Merchandising, Marketing, CRM, Product, Creative, Operations and Finance to deliver shared commercial objectives.

**PERFECTLY PACKAGED**

* A competitive salary
* 33 days holiday rising to 35 with length of service, inclusive of bank holidays.
* A broad benefits package including our staff favourite – a very generous staff discount across both our brands. See all of our benefits on our careers portal.

# Senior Image Retoucher

We usually respond within three days

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We’re excited to be recruiting for a talented, technically minded, and highly creative Senior Image Retoucher to join our Photography and Retouch Team. This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced retoucher who combines exceptional technical expertise with a passion for beautiful imagery, product accuracy and creative storytelling.

You’ll play a key role in bringing our imagery to life across our Joma Jewellery and Katie Loxton brands, taking ownership of the retouch process from shoot handover through to final release. As the technical specialist within the team, you’ll set the standard for product and creative retouching, own our guidelines and workflows, and ensure every image is delivered to the highest possible standard, on time and with product accuracy at the forefront.

Alongside your own hands-on retouching, you’ll make an impact by providing clear direction, mentorship and technical guidance to the wider retouch team. You’ll allocate work, quality-check output, develop best practice and help the team continuously improve. You’ll also work closely with photographers, Creative Production, Design, Content and wider business teams to establish the creative direction for shoots and ensure imagery is consistent from the first frame through to the final asset.

This role is perfect for someone who loves getting into the detail, thrives in a fast-paced creative environment and enjoys being the person others turn to for technical expertise. You’ll also have the opportunity to shape how we use AI-assisted retouching, identifying where new technology can create efficiencies while always protecting the quality, authenticity and accuracy of our products.

**BEHIND THE BRANDS**

We’re a family-run, entrepreneurial company with an exciting pace of life and a bright and friendly team. We are passionate about creating stunning products with a personal touch and innovating our business behind the scenes. We value creativity, collaboration and integrity.

**HOW YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE**

* Own and continuously develop our product and creative retouch guidelines, ensuring the team has clear standards, processes and technical direction to work from.
* Own and refine the end-to-end retouch process, from shoot handover, grading and retouch through to final release, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency and quality.
* Retouch complex, hero, campaign and lifestyle imagery, setting the creative and technical benchmark for the wider team.
* Review and approve product and creative imagery against agreed guidelines, with exceptional attention to colour accuracy, product representation and overall image quality.
* Work closely with the Creative Production Manager and Head of Creative to translate the shoot bible into a clear working grade and retouch reference, agreeing the creative direction and Capture One processing approach for each shoot.
* Attend photoshoots where required, carrying out test edits, establishing the look on the day and helping ensure the creative direction is right before the shoot wraps.
* Act as a key point of contact for retouch requests across the business, providing creative direction and making informed decisions on how imagery should look.
* Own export specifications across relevant platforms, ensuring all imagery is release-ready and carrying out final spot checks before assets are handed over.
* Maintain naming conventions and folder discipline across the image management structure, auditing team compliance and helping to keep our workflows organised.
* Partner with Design, Content and wider business teams to communicate progress, manage expectations and proactively highlight any risks or issues that could impact deadlines.
* Allocate and direct retouch work across the team, creating clear briefs and balancing workload against shoot volumes, priorities and deadlines.
* Train, mentor and develop Midweight Retouchers and freelance support, providing constructive feedback and helping to raise the standard and consistency of the team's output.
* Brief freelance Retouchers on our guidelines and quality standards, reviewing their output and providing feedback to the Retouch Manager.
* Deputise for the Retouch Manager when required, taking ownership of day-to-day priorities, deadlines and escalations.
* Work closely with the Photography Team to identify opportunities for better ways of working and stronger collaboration between photography and retouch.
* Participate in debriefs with E-commerce, Buying, Product, Print and Digital teams to identify improvements and recommend new processes or ways of working.
* Champion a positive, collaborative team environment, leading by example and helping to maintain strong team morale.

**AI-ASSISTED RETOUCHING**

* Use AI-powered tools across Photoshop, Lightroom and Capture One, including Generative Fill, Generative Expand, AI masking and upscaling, to improve efficiency without compromising product accuracy.
* Combine AI-assisted techniques with strong traditional retouching craft, knowing when technology adds value and when a manual approach will deliver the better result.
* Critically review all AI-generated output, ensuring colour, texture, form and detail remain an accurate representation of the product.

They will also deputise for the Brand Editor when required.

* Work closely with the Brand Editor across editorial and social to agree daily priorities, coordinate coverage and ensure a consistent brand voice across platforms.

* Head up planning and tracking of original journalism and exclusive stories

OverviewApplication

LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.

Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.

What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.

With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity.

### About the role

LemFi's Credit tribe is early and moving fast. We're building the infrastructure that will power lending products for millions of people who've historically been locked out of fair credit - immigrants, diaspora communities, and the financially underserved across our 21 operating markets. This is a ground-floor opportunity: the tribe is being built right now, and the systems you design today will be the foundation everything else sits on.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Credit tribe and own core backend services end-to-end. You'll be working primarily in Go, with some existing Java services in the mix - switching between them is not the blocker, deep engineering craft and an instinct for how credit products behave is. We move fast and we don't micromanage, which means you'll need to bring the domain awareness to make the right call before anyone has to tell you.

### What you'll build and own

* Design, build and operate high-reliability backend services that power LemFi's credit products, from loan origination and underwriting through to repayment and collections.
* Make the right architectural calls independently - data residency, service boundaries, state-machine design for loan lifecycles - without needing to be told what a credit-safe system looks like.
* Own your services in production: instrument them, monitor them, debug them, and hold the bar on reliability and correctness.
* Work closely with product and compliance to translate credit-domain requirements into clean, testable, maintainable code.
* Use AI coding tools actively to accelerate delivery and improve test coverage, while taking full ownership of the correctness of every line that ships.
* Contribute to growing the tribe - as one of the earliest engineers you'll help set the engineering culture, review others' work, and raise the bar on how we build.

### Your experience

* Strong backend engineering in Go; Java experience is a plus given our existing services, but Go is the primary language.
* Meaningful fintech experience - you understand how financial systems behave under load, under regulation, and under audit.
* Exposure to credit products (lending, underwriting, repayment, collections) at any level - even adjacent - so you arrive with the right instincts, not just a willingness to learn them.
* Solid grasp of distributed systems design: event-driven architecture, service boundaries, data consistency, and failure modes.
* You care about correctness and data integrity as much as velocity - you've worked in environments where getting it wrong has real consequences for real people.
* Comfortable operating with autonomy in an environment where the spec is never fully finished and the team is still being built.

### Nice to have

* Direct experience building credit decisioning, risk scoring, or loan management systems.
* Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up where you helped establish engineering foundations from scratch.
* Familiarity with regulatory and compliance constraints specific to consumer credit (e.g. FCA, data protection requirements for credit data).

## Why Join LemFi?

Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this.

At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions.

# Information Security Governance and Compliance Analyst

**Great journeys start with great people**Here at LNER, we're shaping the future of rail on one of the UK's most iconic routes. From our high-speed Azuma fleet, redefining long-distance travel, to our next generation of trains, Serenza, this is a moment of real transformation for LNER. We're investing in cutting-edge technology, sustainability, and most importantly our people, to deliver outstanding experiences for our customers. There has never been a more exciting time to grow your career with LNER! 

**So, what exactly does our Information Security Governance and Compliance Analyst do?**LNER is adapting to ensure timely, accurate and focused support to protect against the growing cyber threat the company is facing. Over the next 12 months, the InfoSec team will be involved in several flag ship projects including those specifically coming through the East Cost Digital Programme and the introduction of the new CAF fleet. This is a truly exciting time for InfoSec at LNER.

We are therefore pleased to be recruiting for a new Information Security Governance, Risk & Assurance Analyst and are looking for someone with experience in the delivery of risk controls, governance processes, supplier assurances and compliance programmes. We also require a detailed knowledge of current and future legislation within the information security sector for UK rail.

The Analyst will provide essential support and input into the InfoSec supplier assurance process, managing the initial review to highlight risk or areas for further investigation. They will also support the risk management framework by reviewing the InfoSec risk register and facilitating the delivery of risk treatment plans within the agreed timescales. This would also extend to activities required to manage the ISO27001 Corrective Actions Log and collation and verification of the Continuous Improvement element of the ISO27001 Standard.

This role involves collaboration with all areas of the business to ensure any Information Security requirements in current and future projects is correctly identified and tasks assigned.

The role provides cover to facilitate delivery of ECDP Programme by supporting the Information Security team across various projects, both current and upcoming.

You'll also be involved in:

* Supporting the LNER Information Security Assurance processes, gaining thorough knowledge of the current processes.
* Guiding critical and key suppliers through the process providing concise, accurate reporting to the Information Security Governance, Risk & Assurance Manager for sign off and to the Information Security Manager as required.
* Managing the treatment tasks/plans identified as requiring remediation through the Information Security Risk Register.
* Working with identified risk owners across the business ensuring the ISO27001 Corrective Actions Log is correct and accurately reflects remediations and agreed delivery.
* Supporting the Information Security Manager and Governance, Risk & Assurance Manager conducting security assessments through vulnerability testing and risk analysis as required.
* Coordinating and supporting surveillance audits in support of maintaining LNER's ISO27001 compliant status.
* Coordinating Information Security Policy review in line with an agreed timetable from the Information Security Compliance Manager.
* Acting as a point of contact for Design Authority papers. Undertaking first review of Technical Impact Assessment papers submitted to Design Authority requiring Information Security review. Supporting business owners completing TIA's and High Level Concept papers completing the relevant sections.
* Developing and carrying out information security plans, policies and procedures.
* Coordinating reporting across the tools used for managing assurance and compliance ensuring reporting is accurate, timely and supports decision making.
* Monitoring use of security products data encryption and other security products and procedures.
* Responding to the business day-to-day information security requests and investigating routine security related incidents such as: malware detections, DLP violations, phishing emails, password compromises, general security information support.

**What you'll need**

* Current experience in an information security role, ideally within risk, governance or assurance.
* Working knowledge of common security controls (e.g. firewalls, endpoint protection, logging and monitoring, access management) and the ability to understand and assess their effectiveness.
* An understanding of core security principles and control domains (access control, encryption, vulnerability and patch management, incident response, business continuity).
* Ability to demonstrate and articulate knowledge of compliance with the ISO27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS Directive, and other security Standards.
* Experience using GRC platforms to manage risk registers, controls and assurance activities.
* Experience identifying, assessing, documenting and tracking information security risks, including agreeing treatment plans and following up on remediation.
* Experience reviewing supplier security questionnaires and evidence (e.g. SOC 2 reports, ISO certificates, penetration test summaries) and making risk-based judgements on their adequacy.
* Recognised industry security certification such as CISMP, CompTIA Security+ or equivalent is desirable.
* Experience in providing written and verbal presentations across all levels of a company.
* Demonstrate their knowledge and understanding of basic financial/technical information.
* You'll be an effective team player, experienced at dealing at all levels with effective influencing and negotiating skills.
* Ability to form constructive and proactive working relationships at all levels with all stakeholders whether internal or external.
* Hands on experience of problem-solving and ability to stay calm under pressure.
* ITIL Foundation certification desirable.

**You'll enjoy**

* Free travel on LNER, plus 75% off other companies' tickets (for you and your dependents).
* Discounted international train tickets (after one year's service).
* 50% discount on LNER tickets for friends and family.
* Generous pension scheme.
* Annual cycle to work schemes/electric vehicle scheme.
* Discount, savings and cashback scheme from top retailers.
* Health and wellbeing schemes and discounts.
* A host of training opportunities to help further your career.
* Rewards and awards to recognise when you shine.

**Life at LNER**

We're on a mission to become the UK's most loved, forward-thinking, and responsible train operating company in the UK. This means making a real difference by doing the right thing for our customers, our people, and the communities and destinations we serve. Together, we're shaping the future of rail travel through our passion, our innovation, and our extraordinary people. Our people are at the heart of everything we do. We're committed to creating an inclusive and engaged culture that supports everyone at every stage of their journey. This means that when you're with LNER, you can truly be yourself—and it's why so many of our colleagues choose to stay and grow with us.

* Diversity and inclusion – We are passionate about building a diverse and inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively create opportunities to inspire and attract diverse talent to join LNER. We are committed to supporting all candidates, so if you require any adjustments or assistance at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know.
* Developing our people – We're creating a learning culture that enables our people to be the best they can be. We support development and career journeys with the right tools and resources, aligned to our people priorities: readiness for Great British Rail, the future world of work and strong, people focused leadership that delivers for our people, customers, and business.
* Health and wellbeing - To create a culture where our people can perform at their best, the physical health and mental wellbeing of our people is of paramount importance to us.

**Disclosure and Barring Service****(DBS) check**

At LNER, safety is our top priority. If your application is successful and you're new to the business, we'll carry out a basic DBS check as part of our pre-employment process. This is only takes place once a conditional job offer has been made. The DBS check looks for any unspent convictions and conditional cautions under the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act (ROA) 1974. If there's evidence of an unspent conviction or a conditional caution, the details of these will be reviewed internally by a cross functional panel on a case-by-case basis before a final offer of employment is confirmed. Please note that in some cases, this may result in an offer being withdrawn. Further information on how we collect and use this data is available on our privacy notice.

**Medical screening**

We're a safety conscious business, so when joining LNER in any role you'll need to pass a medical screening and a drugs and alcohol test before we can confirm an unconditional job offer. For safety-critical roles, a safety-critical medical will also be required. Our Talent Team will be on hand to guide you through the process and will send you a medical questionnaire by email. Once complete, this will go directly to our in-house Health and Wellbeing team who will contact you to arrange a convenient location, date and time for your medical appointment. We currently have clinics in Kings Cross, Doncaster, Newcastle and Edinburgh. The sooner we can do it, the better, so please try to be flexible with your availability. Once your medical is approved, we'll finalise any last details and look forward to you joining the team!

The Health Confidence Coach delivers personalised, non-clinical coaching and group education to help Confident Futures participants build self-efficacy, confidence, routine, participation and progression towards work. * Partner closely with the Director of Product and Engineering on complex strategic calls, cross functional alignment and the decisions that have the most long term leverage.
